service: canary

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.12
  region: us-east-1


plugins:
  - serverless-plugin-canary-deployments
  - serverless-domain-manager

custom:
  customDomain:
    domainName: ${param:domain, 'api.example.com'}
    createRoute53Record: false       
    endpointType: 'regional'
    autoDomain: true

functions:
  canary:
    handler: app.canary
    events:
      - http:
          path: canary
          method: get
    deploymentSettings:
      type: Canary10Percent5Minutes
      alias: live

  general:
    handler: app.general
    events:
      - http:
          path: general
          method: get
